content.short: pandADA is a CNFT platform for raising virtual pandas.
content.description:
pandADA is the only Cardano NFT project where users can adopt virtual pandas and play with them in an interactive panda pen. pandADA has several key differentiators that distinguish it from other projects in the space.

Utility on Day Zero: pandADA is committed to creating a fully-functional panda pen and unique CNFT mint process before the first pandas wake up. Pandas need to play, not be put in a wallet!

Distinct Operating Model: 神 ("Kami"), the pandADA deity, creates a small number of new panda CNFTs gradually over time - not 10,000 all at once. He has ordained Mi Mi as Emperor to lead the pandADA pandas.

Long-Term Community: Mi Mi and Nuan Nuan have teamed up to develop pandADA as a sustainable CNFT project on Cardano. 10 or fewer pandas will be born each day, to ensure early pandas don't get jealous!

Actionable Future Goals: Emperor Mi Mi's priorities include improving the pandas' tiny enclosure, helping them procreate, and eventually searching for other panda bases - lengends speak of pandAVAX and pandALGO.

Aside from this, Emperor Mi Mi suggests that you greet him in his panda pen at pandADA.io/panda_pen. There is a good chance he's snoozing when you stop by, but Nuan Nuan would be happy to answer any questions. There's also an adoption center, where you can view available pandas and their special attributes. No two pandas are the same, but all have their unique strengths!
